title: Clark Drops Tony to 64.8, and Four Teams Are 7–4
dek: Clark's 64.6-point beatdown of Tony creates a four-way tie for first, Prithvi comes back from 30% against Stephen, and a 5–6 Clark now has better playoff odds than three of the leaders.

title: Tyler Benches 41.7 Points and Hands Peyton the Game
dek: Peyton comes back from 19% to beat Tyler, Kyle upsets Sagar, Tony is alone in first at 7–3, and a 4–6 Clark is still the league's top-rated team.

title: Tony Hangs 164.3 on Sagar, and Three Teams Share First
dek: Tony posts the week's top score and the season's biggest beatdown, Tony, Tyler and Sagar are all 6–3, and a 4–5 Clark now has 92% playoff odds.
